summary: Roles are cached, so select Update revision on launch to re-download upstream roles before each job; expose extra directories with Paths to expose to isolated Jobs or AWX_ISOLATION_SHOW_PATHS, then restart with automation-controller-service restart after editing the settings file.
questions: How do I make jobs always use the latest version of a role?
Do I need to restart controller after changing AWX_ISOLATION_SHOW_PATHS?
Why are roles cached in automation controller?
